title: Saying Goodbye Politely
paragraphs: Acara pertunangan itu perlahan hampir selesai, dan sebagian besar tamu sudah pulang. Yusuf juga ingin segera pulang, karena ia punya rapat pagi besok, tapi ia tidak ingin pergi tanpa mengucapkan kata perpisahan yang pantas. Ia menghampiri tuan rumahnya di dekat dapur. "Terima kasih banyak sudah mengundang saya malam ini. Saya harus pulang sekarang," katanya sambil tersenyum hangat dan tulus.

"Anda selalu boleh datang ke sini, kapan saja," jawab tuan rumah dengan ramah sambil berjabat tangan. Yusuf mengucap salam sekali lagi sebelum melangkah keluar ke udara malam yang sejuk, merasa berterima kasih atas keramahan yang diterimanya. Dalam perjalanan pulang, Yusuf merenungkan bagaimana perpisahan yang pantas dan tidak terburu-buru meninggalkan kesan jauh lebih baik daripada sekadar menghilang diam-diam. Dalam komunitas yang erat, hal-hal kecil seperti ini diam-diam memperkuat setiap hubungan seiring waktu.
answerKey: The engagement gathering is slowly finishing, and most of the guests have already left. Yusuf wants to head home too, since he has an early meeting tomorrow, but he does not want to leave without a proper word. He walks over to find his host near the kitchen. "Thank you so much for having me tonight. I need to head home now," he says with a warm and genuine smile on his face. "You are always welcome here, anytime," the host replies kindly, shaking his hand. Yusuf says salam one last time before stepping out into the cool evening air, feeling grateful for the warm hospitality he received. On the drive home, Yusuf reflects on how a proper, unhurried goodbye leaves a much better impression than simply slipping away. In a close community, small gestures like this quietly strengthen every relationship over time.
